name: DarkIcon
tagline: 为 iOS 15–18 提供深色图标与图片壁纸暗化。
description: DarkIcon 在 iOS 15–17 为主屏幕、文件夹与 Spotlight 提供跟随系统外观的图标样式，并在 iOS 16–18 为主屏幕与锁屏图片壁纸提供暗化效果。
壁纸暗化可根据图片亮度自适应调整，亮图增强暗化、暗图减少处理；也可手动调节强度并跟随系统深色模式。
iOS 18 保留系统原生图标功能，插件图标样式不会启用；iOS 15–17 可分别配置浅色和深色模式的样式。
可搜索的 App 图库按原图、深色、透明和色调展示已有图标，支持从照片或文件导入原图、深色、透明图片，并可还原单个样式或全部用户图片。导入图直接使用，独立保存，不受图标缓存清理影响；色调可直接复用导入的透明图。
默认浅色模式使用原图，深色模式使用深色图标；透明与色调保留主体颜色，采用可调半透明底板与静态边缘高光，成品和主体均可复用缓存。
iOS 16/17 长按桌面进入编辑后，可通过“编辑 → 自定义”切换图标样式与大小，并调节壁纸暗化；iOS 15 不增加此入口，iOS 18 保留系统原生面板。
notice: 更新后请重新加载 SpringBoard，无需清除图标缓存。首次未生成的图标会在后台处理；无法可靠分离主体的复杂图标可能保留原图。边缘高光为静态效果。壁纸暗化仅支持普通图片壁纸；iOS 15 使用系统自带壁纸暗化。
features: iOS 16–18 主屏幕与锁屏壁纸自适应暗化
根据图片亮度自动调整暗化程度，并支持手动强度调节
壁纸与图标开关独立控制，壁纸暗化默认关闭
iOS 15–17 跟随系统深浅色外观自动切换桌面图标
支持 Spotlight 下拉搜索中的深色图标显示
可搜索的 App 图库，点选应用后查看各样式已有图标及来源
图库按需加载，已加载的预览在当前页面内持续保留
默认浅色模式使用原图；浅色与深色模式可独立选择透明或色调
深色图标使用磁盘缓存与 64 MiB 热缓存，减少重复读盘并支持内存压力回收
统一按 App 身份获取图标并复用缓存，减少重复生成和替换
磁盘已有深色成品时立即使用，避免延迟替换
内存压力与排队任务不会阻挡已有磁盘缓存命中
设置内可清除图标缓存；预览直接复用磁盘结果
改善 Spotlight 重复打开及深浅色切换后的图标恢复
扩展通知、按钮及其他小图标适配，同时保留原始色彩
默认混合模式，并可单独选择 Apple 或 Chroma 模式
优先使用 App 自带深色图标，并增强 iOS 17 原生 Dark 素材读取；可选白色与浅灰色反转
可搜索的“禁用原生深色图标”名单，支持按图标、App 名称或 bundle ID 选择改用当前算法
原生 Dark 与算法策略使用独立缓存，预览同步遵循名单，切换无需清除缓存
改善浅底、渐变、圆角和备用图标的深色效果
改善日历日期与星期的可读性，同时保留主体颜色和细节
浅色／深色模式独立选择原图或深色、透明、色调样式
分别调整色调底色与背景不透明度，保留主体颜色和细节
透明与色调图标加入静态亮边，复用主体与成品磁盘缓存
改善复杂主体、渐变及分段底色的图标处理，保留主体细节
改善相机机身与暗底的区分，并保留镜头、齿轮及灰阶层次
设置内可直接打开 Discord 邀请、复制 QQ 群号和越狱源地址
原图、深色、透明图片可从照片或文件导入，直接使用并独立保存；支持单样式或全部还原
已导入的透明图直接用于色调，清理图标缓存不会删除用户图片
iOS 16/17 桌面自定义面板，支持图标样式、大小与壁纸暗化控制
compatibility: 图标功能支持 iOS 15–17；插件壁纸暗化支持 iOS 16–18
iOS 15 使用系统壁纸暗化；iOS 18 使用系统原生深色图标
桌面自定义面板仅支持 iOS 16/17；iOS 18 保留系统原生面板
usage: 安装插件后重新加载桌面
进入“设置 → 深色图标”分别配置图标与壁纸暗化；浅色／深色模式各自选择样式、底色和背景不透明度，壁纸暗化默认关闭
在“图标图库”中按名称或 bundle ID 搜索 App，点进子页面查看原图、深色、透明和色调的已有图标；点按可管理的样式从照片或文件导入图片，也可还原该样式或全部用户图片
在“禁用原生深色图标”中搜索并勾选 App，使其跳过原生 Dark 并使用当前算法；取消勾选即可恢复原生优先
需要时仍可在设置中使用“清除图标缓存”；主屏幕、文件夹、Spotlight 与预览会统一复用结果
更新插件后重新加载 SpringBoard，无需清除缓存；首次未生成图标会在后台处理
在设置中的社区与越狱源分组打开 Discord 邀请，或点击复制 QQ 群号与源地址
iOS 16/17 长按桌面进入编辑状态，点“编辑 → 自定义”调整图标样式和大小；iOS 18 继续使用系统原生面板

changes: 新增 iOS 16/17 桌面自定义面板，可切换图标样式、大小及壁纸暗化；iOS 18 保留系统原生面板。
图标预览升级为可搜索的 App 图库，点进应用可查看各样式已有图标，从照片或文件导入原图、深色或透明图片，并支持单样式或全部还原。
导入图片直接使用并独立保存，清理图标缓存不会删除；色调直接复用已导入的透明图，已加载预览不再随滚动消失。
修复深色模式下文件夹小图显示浅色及关闭文件夹时短暂变浅的问题。
改善桌面、文件夹与应用启动过渡中的图标一致性，优化缓存复用，减少重复处理与闪烁。
修复部分应用启动、返回桌面时短暂闪回浅色图标的问题。
修复部分图标在启动、最小化时出现半处理和背景残留的问题。
优化图标缓存更新，旧的异常处理结果自动刷新，无需手动清理缓存。
改善深色、透明与色调图标的复杂主体、渐变及分段底色处理，减少背景残留与主体误删，并保留透明／色调主体原色。
改善相机、设置等图标的亮度与灰阶细节，优化透明与色调图标的静态边缘高光。
设置新增同组 Discord、QQ群与越狱源入口，可直接打开邀请，并复制群号或源地址。
新增浅色／深色模式独立的图标样式，可选原图或深色、透明、色调，并分别调整底色与背景不透明度。
改善透明与色调图标处理，保留主体颜色和细节，加入静态边缘高光，并改善浅色、渐变和暗色底的适配。
优化成品与主体缓存复用，减少切换样式、颜色和小图标显示时的重复处理。
改善小图标与桌面图标的深色效果一致性，减少局部残留浅色，并优化缓存复用。
修复 Spotlight 搜索图标刷新时可能出现的空白，改善图标显示稳定性。
新增“禁用原生深色图标”列表，可按图标、App 名称或 bundle ID 搜索并选择应用。
勾选应用将跳过其原生 Dark 素材，改用当前算法；取消勾选即可恢复原生优先。
列表按需后台加载可见图标，原生与算法策略使用独立缓存，预览同步遵循名单，切换无需清除缓存。
统一按 App 身份获取图标并复用缓存，减少重复生成与替换，并改善 Spotlight 重复打开及深浅色切换后的恢复。
扩展通知、按钮及其他小图标适配，同时保留原始色彩。
修复内存压力和排队任务阻挡磁盘缓存的问题，并保留原生 Dark 优先与 64 MiB 热缓存。
修复翻页时深色图标先变亮再重复替换的问题。
深色图标热缓存提升至 64 MiB，配合磁盘缓存减少淘汰与重复读盘，并保留内存压力回收。
磁盘已有成品时直接使用；浅色模式继续返回原图，并保留原生 Dark 优先与缓存清理。
紧急修复 0.9.4 在浅色模式下仍进行不必要图标处理的问题，改善桌面启动。
优化内存与缓存：移除长期原图缓存，深色图标改用磁盘缓存和限额内存缓存。
图标读取与生成改为后台按需执行，保留原生 Dark 优先；设置新增“清除图标缓存”，预览复用磁盘结果。
新增可搜索的图标预览列表，可对比 Light/Dark 效果并标明原生素材或算法处理。
预览按需加载并复用缓存；修复浅色模式残留深色图标，完善主屏幕、文件夹与 Spotlight 刷新。
增强 iOS 17 原生 Dark 素材优先策略，并修复错误图集和预览缩放导致的显示异常。
优化深色图标缓存，浅色模式下继续保留成品，减少主屏幕翻页、文件夹和图标刷新时的重复处理。
完善 Spotlight 深色图标支持，并改进浅底、渐变、圆角及备用图标的处理效果。
改善日历日期与星期的可读性，同时保留图标主体颜色和细节。
新增图片壁纸自适应暗化，可根据壁纸亮度动态调整暗化程度。
壁纸暗化支持 iOS 16–18 主屏幕与锁屏，跟随深色模式并支持手动强度调节；默认关闭。
壁纸与图标功能独立控制：深色图标支持 iOS 15–17，iOS 18 使用系统原生图标。
新增 iOS 17–18 图片壁纸暗化，跟随系统深色模式并支持调节强度。
壁纸与图标功能现可独立控制；壁纸暗化默认关闭。
iOS 18 保留系统原生深色图标；iOS 17 及以下继续使用插件图标功能。
新增默认混合模式，结合 Apple 与 Chroma 两种处理方式，改善不同图标的深色效果。
新增 App 自带深色图标优先与白色、浅灰色反转选项，并支持在设置中重启桌面。
优化首次生成后的缓存复用；首次生成或切换设置时可能短暂卡顿。

en.name: DarkIcon
en.tagline: Dark icons and image wallpaper dimming for iOS 15–18.
description: DarkIcon provides icon styles that follow system appearance across the Home Screen, folders, and Spotlight on iOS 15–17, and dims Home Screen and Lock Screen photo wallpapers on iOS 16–18.
Adaptive wallpaper dimming responds to image brightness, applying more dimming to bright images and less to dark images. Manual intensity control and Dark Mode tracking remain available.
On iOS 18, native system icon features are preserved and tweak icon styles stay disabled. On iOS 15–17, Light and Dark Mode icon styles can be configured independently.

A searchable per-app gallery displays existing Original, Dark, Clear, and Tinted artwork. Import Original, Dark, or Clear images from Photos or Files and restore one style or all imported artwork. Imports are used directly, stored separately, and survive icon-cache clearing; Tinted style reuses an imported Clear image when available.

Defaults remain Original icons in Light Mode and Dark icons in Dark Mode. Clear and Tinted styles preserve subject colors with adjustable translucent backgrounds and static edge highlights; completed icons and subjects are cached for reuse.
On iOS 16/17, enter Home Screen editing and choose Edit → Customize to change icon styles and size or control wallpaper dimming. The entry is not added on iOS 15, and iOS 18 retains its native panel.
en.notice: Respring after updating; no icon cache clearing is required. Previously ungenerated icons finish in the background; complex artwork without a reliable subject may retain its original appearance. Edge highlights are static. Wallpaper dimming supports ordinary photo wallpapers; iOS 15 uses system wallpaper dimming.
features: Adaptive Home Screen and Lock Screen wallpaper dimming on iOS 16–18
Brightness-aware automatic dimming with optional manual intensity control
Independent wallpaper and icon controls, with wallpaper dimming off by default
Home Screen icons that follow system appearance on iOS 15–17
Dark icon support in Spotlight search
Searchable per-app gallery showing existing artwork by style and its source
On-demand gallery loading, with loaded previews retained for the current page
Original icons by default in Light Mode; independent Clear or Tinted choices for Light and Dark Mode
Disk cache plus a 64 MiB hot cache for dark icons, reducing disk reads while retaining memory-pressure cleanup
Retrieve icons and reuse cache consistently by app identity to reduce repeated generation and replacement
Use existing dark disk results immediately to avoid delayed replacement
Memory pressure and queued work do not block existing disk-cache hits
Clear Icon Cache in Settings; previews directly reuse disk results
Improved icon restoration after repeatedly opening Spotlight or switching appearance
Support for notification, button, and other small icons while preserving original colors
Default hybrid mode with individually selectable Apple and Chroma modes
Preference for app-provided dark icons with improved iOS 17 Dark-asset loading and optional white and light-gray inversion
Searchable Disable Native Dark Icons list with app icons, names, and bundle IDs for choosing apps that should use the current algorithm
Separate caches for native Dark and algorithm results, with previews following the list and no cache clearing required when switching
Improved dark results for light backgrounds, gradients, rounded artwork, and fallback icons
Improved Calendar date and weekday readability while preserving subject colors and details
Independent Original or Dark, Clear, and Tinted icon styles for Light and Dark Mode
Separate tint background colors and opacity controls while preserving subject colors and details
Static edge highlights for Clear and Tinted icons, with disk reuse of extracted subjects and completed icons
Improved complex subjects, gradients, and segmented backgrounds while retaining subject details
Improved separation of Camera bodies from dark backgrounds while preserving lens, gear, and tonal detail
Settings entries to open the Discord invite and copy the QQ group number or repository URL
Import Original, Dark, or Clear images from Photos or Files for direct use and separate storage; restore one style or all imports
Tinted style directly reuses imported Clear artwork; icon-cache clearing preserves user images
Home Screen customization panel on iOS 16/17 for icon styles, size, and wallpaper dimming
compatibility: Icon features support iOS 15–17; tweak wallpaper dimming supports iOS 16–18
Uses system wallpaper dimming on iOS 15 and native system dark icons on iOS 18
The added Home Screen customization panel supports iOS 16/17 only; iOS 18 retains its native panel
usage: Open Settings → DarkIcon to configure icons and wallpaper dimming independently; choose styles, background colors, and opacity separately for Light and Dark Mode. Wallpaper dimming is off by default

Search by app name or bundle ID in Icon Gallery, then open an app to view existing Original, Dark, Clear, and Tinted artwork. Tap a managed style to import an image from Photos or Files, or restore one style or all imported artwork
Search and select apps under Disable Native Dark Icons to skip their native Dark assets and use the current algorithm; deselect them to restore native priority
Clear Icon Cache remains available when needed; the Home Screen, folders, Spotlight, and previews consistently reuse results
Respring after updating; no cache clearing is required, and previously ungenerated icons finish in the background
Use the Community and Repository group in Settings to open the Discord invite or copy the QQ group number and repository URL
On iOS 16/17, enter Home Screen editing and choose Edit → Customize to adjust icon styles and size; iOS 18 continues to use the native panel

changes: Adds a Home Screen customization panel on iOS 16/17 for icon styles, size, and wallpaper dimming; iOS 18 keeps its native panel.
Upgrades previews to a searchable per-app gallery for existing styles. Import Original, Dark, or Clear images from Photos or Files, and restore one style or all imported artwork.
Imported artwork is used directly and survives icon-cache clearing. Tinted style reuses imported Clear artwork, and loaded previews remain visible when scrolling.
Fixes folder previews appearing light in Dark Mode and briefly reverting to light when closing a folder.
Improves icon consistency across the Home Screen, folders, and app launch transitions, with better cache reuse to reduce repeated processing and flicker.
Fixes some app icons briefly reverting to Light when launching apps or returning to the Home Screen.
Fixes partially processed icons and background residue during app launch and minimization.
Improves icon cache updates and automatically refreshes previously incorrect results without manual cache clearing.

Improves complex subjects, gradients, and segmented backgrounds in Dark, Clear, and Tinted icons, reducing background residue and accidental subject removal while preserving Clear/Tinted subject colors.
Improves brightness and tonal detail in Camera, Settings, and other icons, and refines static edge highlights in Clear and Tinted styles.
Adds grouped Discord, QQ, and repository entries in Settings to open the invite and copy the group number or repository URL.
Adds independent icon styles for Light and Dark Mode: Original or Dark, Clear, and Tinted, with separate background colors and opacity controls.
Improves Clear and Tinted icons while preserving subject colors and details, adds static edge highlights, and improves handling of light, gradient, and dark backgrounds.
Improves reuse of completed icons and extracted subjects to reduce repeated processing when changing styles or colors and displaying small icons.
Improves consistency between miniature and Home Screen dark icons, reduces partially light artwork, and improves cache reuse.
Fixes blank icons that could occur during Spotlight search refreshes and improves icon display stability.
Added a searchable Disable Native Dark Icons list showing each icon, app name, and bundle ID.
Selected apps skip their native Dark assets and use the current algorithm; deselecting restores native priority.
Visible icons load on demand in the background, native and algorithm results use separate caches, previews follow the list, and no cache clearing is required.
Unified icon lookup and cache reuse by app identity, reducing repeated generation and replacement while improving recovery after reopening Spotlight or switching appearance.
Expanded support for notification, button, and other small icons while preserving their original colors.
Fixed memory pressure and queued work blocking existing disk-cache results while preserving native Dark priority and the 64 MiB hot cache.
Fixed dark icons briefly turning light and then being replaced again while paging.
Raised the dark icon hot cache to 64 MiB, reducing eviction and repeated disk reads while retaining memory-pressure cleanup.
Existing disk results are used immediately; Light Mode continues to use original icons while preserving native Dark priority and cache clearing.
Urgently fixed unnecessary icon processing in Light Mode introduced in 0.9.4, improving Home Screen startup.
Improved memory and caching by removing the long-lived source-image cache and using disk cache plus bounded memory cache for dark icons.
Icon loading and generation now run on demand in the background while preserving native Dark priority; Settings adds Clear Icon Cache and previews reuse disk results.
Added a searchable icon preview list with Light/Dark comparison and native-versus-algorithm labels.
Previews now load on demand and reuse cache; fixed dark icons lingering in Light Mode and improved Home Screen, folder, and Spotlight refreshes.
Improved preference for native Dark assets on iOS 17 and fixed display issues caused by incorrect artwork selection and preview scaling.
Improved dark icon caching by retaining completed results in Light Mode, reducing repeated processing during Home Screen paging, folder access, and icon refreshes.
Improved dark icon support in Spotlight and refined results for light backgrounds, gradients, rounded artwork, and fallback icons.
Improved Calendar date and weekday readability while preserving the icon subject colors and details.
Added adaptive image wallpaper dimming that adjusts dynamically to wallpaper brightness.
Wallpaper dimming now supports the Home Screen and Lock Screen on iOS 16–18, follows Dark Mode, and offers manual intensity control; it is off by default.
Wallpaper and icon features are controlled independently: dark icons support iOS 15–17, while iOS 18 uses the native system icon feature.
Added image wallpaper dimming on iOS 17–18 with Dark Mode tracking and adjustable intensity.
Wallpaper and icon features can now be controlled independently; wallpaper dimming is off by default.
On iOS 18, native system dark icons are preserved and the tweak icon feature stays disabled; the original icon feature remains available on iOS 17 and earlier.
Added a default hybrid mode that combines Apple and Chroma processing for better results across different icons.
Added preference for app-provided dark icons, optional white and light-gray inversion, and a Home Screen restart action in Settings.
Improved cache reuse after initial generation; the first generation or a settings change may cause a brief slowdown.
